source_authority.source: Erik Olin Wright, Classes (Verso, first published 1985), as frozen in the M10 full-source extraction

documentary_loci.source_claim: Unequal productive assets generate structurally different exchange/work strategies; wage labour is one institutional form rather than the mechanism itself.
Productive-asset control/property is upstream of available exchange strategies and dependency outcomes.
Exploitation adds appropriation/interdependence and counterpart productive activity; unemployed/excluded status is not interchangeable with an active exploited wage position.

supporting_ledger_claims: Ch. 1 supplied lines 250-275 and 321-333: structural class analysis concerns relations/empty positions distinct from incumbents and collective actors.
Full-ledger source-level verdict: productive-asset/property relation plus counterpart position plus institutional rules is upstream of objective material stakes/dependencies.
The source extraction is evidence, not automatic architecture authority; Q03 authority below supplies only the bounded project-side semantic admission.

authority_source: HQ 4c2a0e9b0423be77a51284b34e87a3f8ae59a321 authorizes Q03 specifically for M10-M01-derived second objective structural-position source-authority/admission adjudication.

admitted_position.definition: An objective actor/entity structural position constituted at the asserted source/context grain by both (a) lack of effective control over productive assets sufficient for independent production and (b) an active wage-labour sale relation to an exact employer/counterpart under exact institutional rules.
nonconstitutive_or_forbidden_shortcuts: occupation, industry, sector, or job title alone
self-report, belief, preference, appraisal, motivation, disposition, biography, or person-state
bounded-exit restriction unless separately evidenced for the same asserted position
exploitation classification inferred from the position identity alone
exact actor/entity occupant identity as part of position-semantic identity
admitted_position.not_a_mechanism: The candidate is an endpoint/state-of-objective-relations identity. It says what objective position is occupied when its constitutive relations are proven; it does not encode the causal transition from property separation to wage dependency or any downstream effect.

semantic_fact_split.position_semantic_identity: Reusable structural-position meaning; does not identify any incumbent.
semantic_fact_split.law: A qualifying occupant may instantiate the repaired semantic candidate only through a separate authorized objective-position fact/materialization. Changing the occupant changes the later fact identity, not this position-semantic candidate identity.

distinctness_from_existing_positive_base.holding: Distinct. Q73A's owned semantic axis is fiscal incorporation/obligation. The Q03 candidate is constituted by productive-asset noncontrol plus an active wage-labour counterpart relation. Neither identity entails the other and no shared label/coordinate is used to collapse them.

admission_and_current_selection.negative_currentness_law: Candidate currentness is semantic-admission currentness only. It is not a current PREV3POS fact, not present-day world truth, and not a current mechanism/application witness.
admission_and_current_selection.successor_gate: Only a separate independent qualification of this repaired content-addressed semantic candidate may wake next. Actor/entity materialization remains separately gated by applicability, permission, valid-time/currentness, provenance/dependency, and replay authority.

identity_replay.replay_law: Same canonical identity material MUST reproduce the same content_hash and candidate_id. Any change to the position semantics, source tip/blob/loci, project authority, baseline distinctness, or use ceiling creates a different candidate identity.
